en: A black‑and‑white winter street scene in a historic town. Snow covers the ground and roofs, bare trees line the left side behind a fence, and a row of wooden and masonry shopfronts with large display windows runs along the right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the snowy street. The image has printed captions at the bottom indicating the place and publisher.
